bhagavata_skanda12.introduction: Skanda 12 of the Bhagavata Purana groups chapters into a devotional and philosophical progression.
bhagavata_skanda12.scripture_text: This skanda contains chapter-level teachings that prepare the reader for deeper verse-by-verse study.
bhagavata_skanda12.philosophical_explanation: Bhagavata skandas are designed to progressively refine bhakti, ethics, and spiritual understanding.
